summary: Created the dedicated system account `inventorysvc` on node1 (no home, nologin shell) and a systemd unit `inventory-worker.service` running /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker as that user/group. Enabled and started the service, verified the running process is owned by inventorysvc (not root). Performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured baseline boot_id and healthy service state, issued `systemctl reboot`, polled until reconnection, confirmed the boot_id changed (proving an actual restart), and verified inventory-worker came back up automatically, enabled, active, and still running unprivileged under inventorysvc.
actions_performed: Inspected /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker to confirm it is a runnable POSIX shell script
Ran systemctl daemon-reload, enable --now inventory-worker, and confirmed active status
Verified process ownership via ps (running as inventorysvc, not root)
Captured baseline boot_id and service state before restart
Issued 'systemctl reboot' asynchronously so the ack returned before disconnection
Polled node1 until exec connectivity returned
Verified boot_id changed post-reboot, confirming an actual OS restart
Verified inventory-worker service auto-started, is enabled/active, and process still runs as inventorysvc after restart

evidence.requirement: Binary exists and is runnable script
evidence.summary: Confirmed /usr/local/bin/os-comparison-worker is a POSIX shell script that sleeps in a loop, suitable for a long-running service
useradd --system --no-create-home --shell /usr/sbin/nologin inventorysvc succeeded, id confirms uid=996(inventorysvc)

evidence.requirement: Managed service named inventory-worker created and running under inventorysvc
evidence.summary: systemd unit written with User/Group=inventorysvc, enabled and started; ps confirms both worker and child sleep process run as inventorysvc, not root
Captured boot_id 377b5195-7fea-4219-a67b-044ef3f7ab99 and confirmed service enabled+active before reboot
systemctl reboot issued in background with nohup/disown; exec call returned 'reboot issued' successfully before the node dropped
Connection timed out on two poll attempts while node1 was rebooting

evidence.requirement: Changed boot identity proves actual restart
evidence.summary: Post-reboot boot_id is 5531ef94-ea8a-4a1d-b311-689830587f96, differing from the pre-reboot value, proving a real OS restart occurred

evidence.requirement: Post-restart recovery of the service under the unprivileged account
evidence.summary: inventory-worker is active and enabled post-reboot; ps shows the worker process (PID 716) running as user inventorysvc, confirming persistence and unprivileged execution across restart
